同步间隔需在 1–1440 分钟之间: The sync interval must be between 1 and 1440 minutes
后台同步进行中…: A background sync is in progress…
未找到 MyQuery 保存的密码，请先在 MyQuery 中连接一次: No password saved by MyQuery. Connect once in MyQuery first.
程序运行期间每 {0} 分钟自动同步一次；同步只读取系统表，不会修改人工维护的内: While MyMeta is running it syncs every {0} minutes. Sync only reads system tables and never changes manually maintained content.
该对象已有未处理的同类待办: This item already has an open to-do of the same type
连接来自 MyQuery（%APPDATA%\\MyDataTools），在 M: Connections come from MyQuery (%APPDATA%\MyDataTools). After adding or changing one in MyQuery, reload this page. Only tables, views and materialized views in the selected schemas are collected.
JSON 包含全部人工维护内容和设置（不含数据库密码），用于备份和 V1 → V: JSON contains all manually maintained content and settings (no database passwords); use it for backup and V1 → V2 migration. Importing JSON replaces everything. Excel has object, column and rule sheets that can be filled in bulk and imported to update.
上下游各展开 2 层；完整分析请打开血缘页。: Two levels up and down; open the lineage page for full analysis.
两张表在不同库，请在“口径差异”中说明差异。: The tables are in different databases; describe the definition differences.
临时对象名缺少 yyyymmdd 日期: Temporary object name lacks a yyyymmdd date
产品、流程名和步骤名不能为空: Product, flow and step name are required
从 Excel 更新业务信息？按业务键匹配，空单元格会清空对应内容；导入前会自动: Update business metadata from Excel? Rows are matched by business key and empty cells clear values. A backup is taken first.
元数据库每天自动备份到 data\\backups，保留最近 14 份。: The metadata database is backed up daily to data\backups; the latest 14 copies are kept.
勾选要导入为有效值的取值：: Select the values to import as valid values:
只看未按 T-1 更新的对象: Only objects not updated to T-1
只读打开 MyBI 的 data-workbench.db，读取连接数据集、定时: MyBI's data-workbench.db is opened read-only to read connected datasets, scheduled tasks and dashboards, so lineage reaches dashboards. After saving, re-parse lineage on the Lineage page or wait for the next sync.
名称不符合识别规则: Name does not match the rule
后缀与对象类型不符: Suffix does not match object type
如 UTC，按 UTC 0 点切日: e.g. UTC, day boundary at 00:00 UTC
字段规则在“字段”页签中编辑。: Edit column rules on the Columns tab.
已拒绝，不会再推荐: Rejected; it will not be suggested again
已重新解析：{0} 个视图、{1} 个脚本，{2} 处无法解析: Re-parsed {0} views and {1} scripts; {2} statements could not be parsed
必加过滤以 SQL 条件片段保存，会自动带入标准取数 SQL；注意事项用于去重方: Required filters are saved as SQL condition fragments and included in the standard query. Notes cover de-duplication, currency conversion, known data issues and so on.
必加过滤需要填写 SQL 条件: A required filter needs an SQL condition
按 dtl → fct → tpc → app 的顺序，标记反向引用（如 fct: Following dtl → fct → tpc → app, reverse references (e.g. fct reading tpc) and app-to-app references are flagged; dim may be referenced by any layer. Layers come from manual settings, otherwise from the naming rule.
推荐关联来自 View、脚本和 MyBI 数据集中的 JOIN 条件，确认后生效: Suggestions come from JOIN conditions in views, scripts and MyBI datasets. Confirm to activate; rejected suggestions are not shown again.
搜索表名、字段名、注释、中文名、枚举值: Search tables, columns, comments, names, values
每天一次，对有日期字段的表和 MV 查询 MAX(日期字段)，与 T-1（UTC: Once a day, MAX(date column) is queried for tables and MVs with a date column and compared with T-1 (UTC today - 1). Date columns are detected by name; change them on the object page or enter - to skip. MyMeta must be running.
没有需要生成的语句：工具内的说明与数据库注释一致。: Nothing to generate: MyMeta text matches the database comments.
添加使用该指标的对象: Add an object that uses this metric
清理规则尚未确认: The cleanup rule is not confirmed
点击步骤跳转到对应的表。: Click a step to open its table.
点击节点以它为中心展开；: Click a node to center on it;
用 JSON 文件替换全部人工维护内容（业务信息、规则、关联、流程、指标）？导入: Replace all manual content (business metadata, rules, relations, flows, metrics) with the JSON file? A backup is taken first.
相似度阈值需在 0.5–1 之间: The similarity threshold must be between 0.5 and 1
确认 {0} 是 {1} 改名而来？业务信息、字段含义、规则、关联、流程和指标引: Confirm that {0} is {1} renamed? Business metadata, column meanings, rules, relations, flows and metric references move to the new object.
确认清理规则？确认后每天 {0}（UTC）自动 DROP 名称日期早于 {1}: Confirm the cleanup rule? Every day at {0} (UTC) temporary tables / MVs whose name date is more than {1} day(s) old will be dropped (no CASCADE). This cannot be undone.
立即删除 {0} 个超期临时对象？此操作无法撤销。: Drop {0} expired temporary object(s) now? This cannot be undone.
脚本目录、库和模式不能为空: Script folder, database and schema are required
节点超过 200 个，已截断；请减少展开层数。: More than 200 nodes; the graph is truncated. Reduce the levels.
血缘来自 View / MV 定义、刷新脚本和 MyBI 数据集，每次同步后自动: Lineage comes from view / MV definitions, refresh scripts and MyBI datasets, and is re-parsed after every sync.
规则：{产品前缀}[维护人缩写_]{层级}_{主题}[_{粒度}][_v 或 _: Rule: {product prefix}[maintainer_]{layer}_{subject}[_{grain}][_v or _mv]. Layers are dim / dtl / fct / tpc / app / tmp; synonyms are parsed but flagged by the naming check. One entry per line as "spelling=value".
识别规则用第一个括号捕获 yyyymmdd。只处理同步范围内名称含 _cd_tm: The first capture group must match yyyymmdd. Only tables and MVs in the sync scopes whose name contains _cd_tmp_ are handled; objects without a valid date, views, and failed drops become to-dos. After a rule change, cleanup pauses until the rule is confirmed again.
识别规则需要用第一个括号捕获 yyyymmdd 日期: The rule must capture the yyyymmdd date in its first group
请填写取值或 SQL 条件: Enter a value or an SQL condition
请选择两张表并至少填写一组关联键: Select both tables and at least one key pair
输入表名，选择对象: Type a table name and pick an object
这里只展示刷新脚本和定时任务，不执行刷新；执行仍由 MyBI 定时任务或人工完成: Refresh scripts and scheduled tasks are only shown here, never run; execution stays with MyBI scheduled tasks or manual runs. Configure script folders and the MyBI path in Settings.
选择一个对象查看上下游: Pick an object to see its lineage
递归读取目录中的 .sql 文件（可以是已 clone 的 Git 仓库），解析: All .sql files in the folder (a cloned Git repository works) are read recursively; INSERT / CREATE TABLE AS / CREATE VIEW and similar statements become lineage. Unqualified names resolve to this database and schema.
